record.question: The modulus of rupture of concrete in terms of its characteristic cube compressive strength (fck) is MPa according to IS 456: 2000 is
record.explanation: Checked the printed source page (Civil Engineering Paper-I-2018, PDF page 1, Q2): the four options are actually (a) 5000 f_ck, (b) 5000 sqrt(f_ck), (c) 0.7 sqrt(f_ck), (d) 0.7 f_ck - the radical signs were dropped in text extraction, which is why the bank string shows duplicated pairs. IS 456:2000 Table 11 gives the modulus of rupture f_r = 0.7 sqrt(f_ck) for grades M20-M50 (e.g. f_ck = 20 -> 0.7 x 4.47 = 3.13 N/mm2, matching Table 12), so the correct printed option is (c), index 2. Confidence is medium only because the bank option text itself is defective (index 2 and index 3 read identically as '0.7 f ck'); the printed page itself is unambiguous.
